parameters.name: CasId
parameters.description: The ID of the SSL Certificates Service certificate. This parameter is required when CertType is set to cas.

parameters.name: CasRegion
parameters.description:
The region of the SSL Certificates Service certificate. This parameter is required when CertType is set to cas. Valid values:
- Chinese mainland accounts: cn-hangzhou.
- International accounts: ap-southeast-1.

parameters.name: CertType
parameters.description:
The certificate type. This parameter is required when SslFlag is set to on. Valid values:
- **free**: free certificate.
- **upload**: uploaded certificate.
- **cas**: SSL Certificates Service certificate.

parameters.name: Certificate
parameters.description: The certificate content. This parameter is required when CertType is set to upload.

parameters.name: HostnameId
parameters.description: The ID of the SaaS domain name. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListCustomHostnames](~~3018667~~) operation.

parameters.name: PrivateKey
parameters.description: The certificate private key. This parameter is required when CertType is set to upload.

parameters.name: RecordId
parameters.description: The ID of the record to bind. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListRecords](~~2850265~~) operation.

parameters.name: SslFlag
parameters.description:
The SSL switch. Valid values:
- **on**: Enables SSL.
- **off**: Disables SSL.
